title: lead.deferred
description: The target company already has an active lead; the single-thread rule (one_active_lead_per_company) blocked creation and a status='deferred' placeholder was inserted instead. A normal business outcome, not an error. Emitted by Lead Generation / scripts/import_leads.py. Consumed by a scheduled re-evaluation (orchestrator/schedules.py, not built yet).

blocked_by_lead_id.description: The active lead currently occupying this company. Null only in the narrow window where the blocking row could not be identified before the deferred insert (see repositories.create_lead).
